patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality food photography is used extensively for hero sections and key content blocks, creating an immersive visual experience.
Content is segmented into distinct horizontal sections, each featuring a unique background color or texture to create visual breaks and hierarchy.
A prominent, decorative serif font is used for main headings, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a balance of expressiveness and readability.
A warm, earthy color palette dominated by deep reds, creams, and yellows, accented by dark green and black, evokes a sense of heritage and culinary richness.

The primary navigation bar transforms upon scrolling, changing from a transparent overlay with light text to a fixed bar with a solid background, dark text, and a distinctive red wavy decorative border.
The hero background image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling at a slower rate than the foreground content to create a sense of depth.
Extensive use of custom, hand-drawn line-art illustrations (e.g., map of Canada, various food items) adds a playful, artisanal, and unique brand character throughout the site.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a large, full-bleed background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the page content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.

The primary navigation bar is initially transparent with light text, overlaying the hero image. Upon scrolling down, it becomes fixed at the top of the viewport, transitioning to a solid background with dark text and revealing a distinct, decorative wavy border underneath.
Content is organized into full-width horizontal sections, each featuring a unique background color or texture, often with large, impactful imagery or custom illustrations to define content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, expressive serif headings (up to ~4-5x body size) contrast with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all elements, including buttons, cards, and image frames, contributing to a clean, defined aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while product grids maintain a tighter, organized rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a rich, warm color palette combined with charming, hand-drawn line-art illustrations, particularly the transforming sticky navigation with its unique wavy border, creates a memorable artisanal and inviting brand identity that feels both heritage and modern.
